message: ソルティア

name: Soltia
message: 「No matter how strong the Crusaders have become, in a one-on-one fight, I'm guaranteed to win.」

name: Soltia
message: 「All you have to do is lure that man here. Simple, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「And what will you do once I lure him out?」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'll be the one to dirty my hands.」

name: Azel
message: 「...You intend to kill him?」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's right.」

name: Azel
message: 「Tch!」
For an instant, Azel's figure wavered in the released Spirit Power, her silhouette growing hazy.

name: Soltia
message: 「Kh!」
Soltia leaped backward and lightly bit the little finger of her right hand.
A few drops of blood splattered at her feet.

name: Soltia
message: 「O circle of my dominion, pour the chaos flowing within this body into me!」
The fresh blood flared up,
and the magic circle beneath Soltia's feet began to glow.
The female teacher's form shimmered and melted away like a heat haze, revealing the form of a Demon.

name: Soltia
message: 「Just to ask, what's the big idea?」
Blazing cross-shaped crests surfaced on both of Azel's palms.
With her at the center, Spirit Power as dense as the ocean floor spread through the space.

name: Soltia
message: 「I see... So it was nothing more than a temporary alliance after all!」

name: Azel
message: 「Is this all you have?」

name: Soltia
message: 「What!?」

name: Melilot
message: 「This is... likely an advanced form of Spell Formula 99.」
When Melilot looked up,
shooting stars streaked across and filled the entire night sky.

name: Melilot
message: 「Pre-Materialize? No way!? How!? It shouldn't be possible yet!?」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't flatter yourself. There was never any alliance between you and me from the very beginning.」

name: Soltia
message: 「No way! Is it surpassing Bylous in absolute value!?」

name: Soltia
message: 「Two times... three times... It's still rising!?」

name: Melilot & Soltia
message: 「Impossible.」

name: Melilot
message: 「But if it were possible.」

name: Soltia
message: 「The only thing capable of causing this phenomenon.」

name: Melilot
message: 「Is just one thing.」

name: Soltia
message: 「There's only one.」

name: Melilot & Soltia
message: 「Re-Crea!?」

name: Azel
message: 「I am the Lord's proxy and executioner!」

name: Azel
message: 「Die.」
The glow of the magic circle surrounding Soltia faded.

name: Soltia
message: 「I don't really mind. Even if you kill me.」

name: Azel
message: 「What!?」
Soltia smiled as her hair fluttered in the raging aftermath of Spirit Power.

name: Soltia
message: 「With this much power, you could probably kill the Demon Lord and even Nive.」

name: Soltia
message: 「And of course, Synn Sakura too.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Then nothing will stand in the way of Re-Crea. My wish will come true even without me. So I don't care if I die right here.」

name: Azel
message: 「I... will kill Synn...」

name: Soltia
message: 「You'll kill me here, then kill Bylous next, and if the Demon Lord shows up, you'll kill him too--and in the end, you'll kill him. With that unrivaled power of yours.」

name: Azel
message: 「I will...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even if you don't kill him, once Re-Crea happens, everything will die and be reborn.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Because that is God's will. In the end, you're the one who will kill him.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... guh... kuhaah.」
Azel suddenly clutched her chest and fell to her knees.

name: Azel
message: 「Stop it...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Defeating all enemies of Re-Crea is God's will, isn't it? And God's will is absolute, right? To you, at least.」

name: Azel
message: 「Ugh... guh... aghh.」

name: Melilot
message: 「It's subsiding...?」

name: Soltia
message: 「I see. So your fanaticism has cracked.」

name: Azel
message: 「No... I am... the Proxy.」
Soltia looked down at the kneeling Azel with open pity and contempt.

name: Soltia
message: 「Even so, as you are now, you probably couldn't even kill me.」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's precisely why I'll kill him for you.」

name: Azel
message: 「I won't... allo--ugh...」

name: Soltia
message: 「He's an obstacle to you carrying out God's will. That's precisely why I'll eliminate him for you.」

name: Azel
message: 「Don't underestimate me... I'll... him...」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'll kill him for you. So that you can remain God's Proxy.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Do you intend to defy God's will?」

name: Azel
message: 「Someone like you has no right to presume the Lord's will! I am the Lord's Proxy!」
A cold voice cut over Azel's agonized scream.

name: Soltia
message: 「Re-Crea is God's will. Your will is God's will.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Those who defy Re-Crea are heretics who defy God's will. And those who are heretics to God are heretics to you as well, aren't they?」

name: Azel
message: 「Of course they are!」

name: Soltia
message: 「Then he, who defies God's will, must be eliminated sooner or later. Though even if he didn't defy it, God intends to remake everything anyway.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You won't even have to dirty your own hands, so you ought to be thanking me.」

name: Azel
message: 「Do you... have no hesitation?」

name: Soltia
message: 「None at all.」

name: Azel
message: 「Even you... will die if the world perishes.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I'm not afraid of dying. My wish is to be reborn as an angel. I told you before, didn't I?」

name: Azel
message: 「Ridiculous. You, a demon, becoming an angel... Impossible.」

name: Soltia
message: 「You know that all demons are descendants of angels, right?」

name: Azel
message: 「I know. Fallen angels.」

name: Soltia
message: 「There was a group of demons who took notice of that. They thought: the average angel possesses far greater combat power than the average demon.」

name: Soltia
message: 「So if they purified the angelic traits remaining in demon blood, wouldn't a demon with immense Spirit Power be born?」

name: Soltia
message: 「They gathered knowledge of Spirit Arts and married exclusively within demon bloodlines morphologically close to angels, purifying that blood over many generations.」

name: Azel
message: 「Could it be.」

name: Soltia
message: 「That's right. I am a descendant of that clan. A demon infinitely close to an angel.」

name: Soltia
message: 「I can read angelic script to a fair degree, and I can use Spirit Arts to a fair degree too.」

name: Azel
message: 「But... you are...」

name: Soltia
message: 「Yes, I am nothing more than a demon. Everything is only to a fair degree. I can't even completely decipher your seal.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Being infinitely close is just the flip side of still not being the same, after all.」

name: Azel
message: 「So that's why... you wish to be reborn...」

name: Soltia
message: 「For generations, my clan tried, and tried, and exhausted every idea. Yet they never found a way to remake a demon into an angel.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Other than being reborn through Re-Crea, there is no way for me to become an angel.」

name: Soltia
message: 「To you, who was born an angel from the very beginning, it must seem like a trivial dream.」
Azel started to say something, but in the end, said nothing.

name: Soltia
message: 「Ever since I was little, I was told, 'You are different from other demons, you are a special demon who can become an angel,' and it got to my head.」

name: Soltia
message: 「It's ridiculous, isn't it? I know that much.」

name: Soltia
message: 「But if it's to make my dream come true, I'll do anything.」

name: Azel
message: 「...Being an angel might not be all that great, you know.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Hehe.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Yes. That may be true. Once I actually become one, I suppose I'll end up having my own share of grievances.」

name: Soltia
message: 「Even so, I want to become an angel. Even if doing so brings about the destruction of the world. Not being able to become an angel is far more terrifying to me than the world's end.」
Soltia's expression as she said this was terribly innocent,
and Azel instinctively readied her Leica.
